notes: Access: direct HTTP GET (curl, desktop UA) - tier 1 sufficient. robots.txt: 'User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow:' (empty disallow = allow all) -> explicit permission, no block. Site is a React SPA shell but category listing pages (e.g. /luxury-home/c-lsh14?...&q=:relevance:category:<CODE>) embed a server-rendered window.initialData JSON containing productListingData.facetdatacategory (full L1-L4 category tree with per-node 'quantity') and productListingData.pagination.totalResults for the query's own node - both parsed locally with Python, no browser needed. Tree source: fetched https://luxury.tatacliq.com/luxury-home/c-lsh14 (top 'Home' department, code LSH14, 25212 total products), extracted facetdatacategory tree (276 nodes). Only Bathroom-relevant branch found: Home > Bath (LSH1416, qty 582) with two children: Bath Accessories (LSH1416100, qty 134) and Bath linen (LSH1416102, qty 448). No bathroom fixtures/sanitaryware/taps/showers/baths/vanities/bathroom-storage/bathroom-mirrors exist anywhere on site (checked full tree incl. Decor, Storage, Home Furnishing, Kitchen, Health&Fitness, Bed departments - none named bath/shower/toilet/vanity/faucet/basin/bidet outside the Bath node). This is a curated multi-brand luxury home-decor/accessories marketplace (Nicobar, Good Earth, Mason Home, etc.), not a sanitaryware/fixtures retailer. Qty verification: re-fetched each leaf URL directly; productListingData.pagination.totalResults matched the tree's 'quantity' exactly for every recorded node (63, 71) - both HTTP 200, node selected=true in facetdatacategory confirming correct node identity (not a wrong-slug fallback). Sample product titles for LSH1416100103 (Accessories, 63): 'Mason Home Beige Plastic Toilet Brush', 'INV Home Grey Soap Dispenser', toothbrush caddies, shower caddies, towel stands/trays, toilet paper holder - genuine bathroom accessories, correctly hierarchy-owned by Bathroom. Sample titles for LSH1416100104 (Soap Dish & Dispenser, 71): soap dispensers/dishes, toilet roll holder - genuine Bathroom accessories per rule 13. Exclusions/routing: Bath linen (LSH1416102, 448) and its children Bath Mats (208, LSH1416102100), Bathrobes (13, LSH1416102101), Towels (227, LSH1416102102) are textile products grouped under 'Bath linen' alongside Bathrobes/Towels -> ROUTED TO TEXTILE per rules 15/16/20 (textile hardware exception towel rail/hook does not apply - these are the textile items themselves, not hardware). Also a separate 'Designer > Bath linen > Sets' node (LSH1412120102, qty 3) under the Designer branch -> same textile routing. Decor > Home Accent > Mirrors (LSH1418103105, 106) is a general decorative-mirror category under the Decor/Home Accent hierarchy, not the Bath hierarchy -> not Bathroom (rule 11/24, belongs to Wall Decor's own extraction, out of scope here, no action taken). Cross-category dedup: checked all recorded and excluded leaf URLs against cross_category_url_index.json - all returned null (no prior extraction hit) via the mandated lookup. No fabrication; all qty figures are the site's own facet counts, cross-verified against live SSR pagination.totalResults on the exact node URL.
